intro: Hogger is the vicious chieftain of the Riverpaw gnolls prowling southwestern Elwynn Forest. Towering over his kin and remarkably aggressive, he has become notorious for raiding local farms and butchering unsuspecting travelers. His violent rampages have earned him an official bounty from the Stormwind Marshals.

p: Prowling atop Hogger Hill in southwestern Elwynn Forest, Hogger commands the local Riverpaw pack with unmatched savagery. In the years following the Third War, gnoll raids across local homesteads grew increasingly bold and coordinated. Behind this rise in violence lies an unsettling alliance: the Riverpaw have begun colluding with the Defias Brotherhood, trading raw ferocity for arms, tactical direction, and magical support. To safeguard Elwynn's borders and protect trade routes from further bloodshed, Marshal Dughan has posted a generous bounty on Hogger's head.
